note: Type 'official' = publisher is the NFL, a Mexican government body, or GitHub. Type 'secondary' = news/blog, used only where flagged. The sandbox can reach nfl.com and diputados.gob.mx through the fetch tool; bash network access is limited to github/npm/pypi. Additional official method references (NIST/scikit-learn) support general evaluation methods only; official NFL references are discovery links and do not imply data rights or feed access.
